def run_cmd(cmd):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

def compare(name, cmd_orig, cmd_mine):
    code_o, out_o, err_o = run_cmd(cmd_orig)
    code_m, out_m, err_m = run_cmd(cmd_mine)

    ok = True
    if code_o != code_m:
        print(f"[{name}] FAIL: return code orig={code_o} mine={code_m}")
        ok = False
    if out_o != out_m:
        print(f"[{name}] FAIL: stdout mismatch")
        print("--- ORIG stdout ---")
        print(out_o.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
        print("--- MINE stdout ---")
        print(out_m.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
        ok = False
    if err_o != err_m:
        print(f"[{name}] FAIL: stderr mismatch")
        print("--- ORIG stderr ---")
        print(err_o.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
        print("--- MINE stderr ---")
        print(err_m.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
        ok = False

    if ok:
        print(f"[{name}] PASS")

# 1. Version / Help / Errors
compare("help -h", "./executable -h", "./test_bin -h")
compare("version -v", "./executable -v", "./test_bin -v")
compare("invalid -sort", "./executable -sort foo", "./test_bin -sort foo")
compare("invalid -format", "./executable -format foo", "./test_bin -format foo")
compare("no stdin pipe", "./executable", "./test_bin")
compare("nonexistent file", "./executable -file nonexist.json", "./test_bin -file nonexist.json")
EOF
python3 compare_test.py
